content.title: -ever 与 no matter 引导的让步状语从句速查
content.intro: whatever/whoever/whichever/wherever/whenever/however 引导让步状语从句,意为“无论……”,都可换成 no matter + what/who/which/where/when/how。判断口诀:看从句缺什么成分,就用对应的 -ever 词;这些词本身充当主语/宾语/限定词/状语,所以 though/although 不能替换。

headers: 在从句中的角色 / 例句
rows: 指物,作主语/宾语/限定词:Whatever happens, stay calm.
指人,作主语/宾语:Whoever finds the ice will help us.
从一组中择一,作限定词:Whichever path you take, be careful.
指地点,作状语:Wherever they go, animals find cities in their way.
指时间,作状语:Whenever a fire breaks out, leave calmly.
表程度:However hard it is, don't give up.

specialRules.rule: however 在这里 = no matter how,后面必须紧跟形容词或副词,再接“主语+谓语”
specialRules.mark: However fast the birds fly, some still crash.(However + adv. + 主谓)

specialRules.rule: 别把让步的 however 和表示“但是”的 however 混淆
specialRules.mark: It is dangerous; however, we go on.(=but,作连接副词)

specialRules.rule: whatever/whoever 既能引导让步状语,也能引导名词性从句作主语/宾语
specialRules.mark: 让步:Whatever happens, … ｜ 名词从句:Take whatever you need.

specialRules.rule: though/although 引导让步从句时后接“完整主谓”,不能充当从句的主语/宾语/限定词
specialRules.mark: Although he committed crimes √ / Although happens ×

why: -ever 词把“让步”和“在从句里充当某个成分(主语/宾语/状语/限定词)”合二为一,所以它后面跟的是一个缺成分的从句;though/although 只表让步、不充当成分,因此两者不能互换。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:根据从句缺的成分及指人/指物/指地点/指时间,选 whatever/whoever/wherever/whenever/however。
however + adj./adv. = no matter how 是易错点;however 后绝不能直接接名词。
-ever 词与 no matter + 疑问词 的互换改写常考。

examVsReal.exam: No matter what happens, we will go on.（考试/书面)
examVsReal.note: 口语里 -ever 单词形式更简洁,意思完全相同

examVsReal.exam: However hard it is, she keeps trying.（考试)
examVsReal.real: No matter how hard it is, she keeps trying.
examVsReal.note: 两种写法可互换;口语两者都常见
